sloka: चक्रहस्तो यथा विष्णुः सर्वान् असुर सत्तमान् ।एतत् च अन्यत् च बहुशो ब्रुवाणाः परम ऋषयः ॥३-२३-२९॥
transliteration: cakrahasto yathā viṣṇuḥ sarvān asura sattamān ।etat ca anyat ca bahuśo bruvāṇāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥3-23-29॥

translations.english: The great ascetics were talking thus and more. The gods waiting eagerly on heavenly chariots saw the army of the demons whose life span was shortened (who were doomed to death).
